title: ジュニアカップにむけて

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The Junior Cup… If I can show what I'm made of here, the Classics will only be a leap away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I've always dreamed about racing in the Classics. Maybe McQueen won't even be there…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Aaaahh! No, no, no! Stop that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm filled with bad thoughts of being relieved if McQueen isn't there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: If I'm this quick to get wimpy, forget about the Classics… I won't even make it past today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, yell some sense into me! I deserve it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I promised that I'd get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I have to show that I can do it! Both to you and to my grandma—she still believes in me too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: If I'm really gonna become the buffest of the buff, then it shouldn't matter who I race against!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So keep your eyes on me today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna prove here today that I, Mejiro Ryan, am worthy of racing in the Classics!
